practices.practice: Read the cluster connection string from an environment variable (DOCUMENTDB_URI) at runtime and never commit the URI or primary key to source control or logs.

practices.practice: Keep a single long-lived MongoClient (process-wide singleton) and reuse it across requests rather than creating a new client per request.
practices.prior_belief: Keep a single long-lived MongoClient (or equivalent) per process and reuse it across requests; configure maxPoolSize/minPoolSize instead of creating a client per request.

practices.practice: Always require TLS on MongoDB connections to Azure DocumentDB (tls=true / ssl=true) and validate server certificates; never disable certificate verification in production.

practices.practice: Store DocumentDB connection strings and other API keys in environment variables or in Azure Key Vault; avoid printing them and rotate keys regularly.
practices.prior_belief: Store provider API keys (e.g., OPENAI_API_KEY, DocumentDB keys) in Azure Key Vault or environment variables and reference them at runtime; rotate keys periodically and avoid printing them to logs.

practices.practice: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff for transient errors and explicitly honor throttling responses (HTTP 429) by reading the service-provided retry header (e.g., x-ms-retry-after-ms / Retry-After) before retrying.
practices.prior_belief: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff for transient errors and explicitly handle HTTP 429 / RequestRateTooLarge responses by reading the Retry-After header and delaying before retrying.

practices.practice: Use structured filters inside the cosmosSearch operator (the 'filter' field) to narrow candidates (e.g., specialty, language, insurance) before vector similarity search rather than post-filtering after kNN.
practices.prior_belief: Use structured filters to narrow candidate documents before running vector similarity: first filter by specialty / language / insurance (indexed fields), then run vector search within that filtered subset (hybrid filter+vector query).
practices.source_name: documentdb-vector-search

practices.practice: Create Mongo-style single-field or compound indexes on fields used in equality or range filters (e.g., specialty, languages, acceptedInsurance) and prefer compound indexes (ESR: Equality→Sort→Range) when queries combine fields.
practices.prior_belief: Create Mongo-style indexes on all fields used in equality or range filters (e.g., specialty, languages, acceptedInsurance) and create compound indexes if queries commonly combine those fields.
practices.source_name: documentdb-indexing

practices.practice: Create a cosmosSearch vector index with dimensions set to the embedding model's output size and choose the similarity metric (COS/IP/L2) to match how you compare embeddings.
practices.prior_belief: Create a vector index on the embedding field with a fixed numberOfDimensions matching the embedding model (e.g., 1536 for OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) and set the index's metric/similarity (cosine, dot, or euclidean) to match how embeddings are compared.
practices.source_name: Integrated vector store in Azure DocumentDB (vector-search examples)

practices.practice: Tune ANN index parameters (HNSW: m, efConstruction; IVF: numLists; DiskANN: lBuild/maxDegree) and set query-time parameters (efSearch / lSearch / lSearch >= k) after measuring recall vs latency.
practices.prior_belief: When creating an HNSW vector index tune key parameters (M/connectivity and efConstruction) for acceptable index build time vs search quality, and set efRuntime (efSearch/topK) at query time to control recall and performance.
practices.source_name: documentdb-vector-search

practices.practice: Store embeddings as a fixed-length number[] (array of floats) in a dedicated field (e.g., embedding) and avoid duplicating full embeddings in multiple fields.
practices.prior_belief: Store embeddings as a fixed-length array of floats (consistent numeric type) in a dedicated field (e.g., embedding: [float,...]); avoid storing duplicate full embeddings in multiple fields and exclude embeddings from default projections when returning documents.
practices.source_name: Integrated vector store in Azure DocumentDB (vector-search)

practices.practice: When returning API responses, project out (exclude) the embedding vector and return only the metadata fields and the similarity score to reduce network and client processing costs.
practices.prior_belief: When responding to API calls, project out the embedding vector (exclude it) and only return the metadata (name, specialty, languages, acceptedInsurance, score) to reduce network and client processing costs.
practices.source_name: documentdb-vector-search

practices.practice: Keep embedding dimensions and embedding model consistent across all documents and store metadata fields (embeddingModel, embeddingDims, embeddingVersion) so you can detect drift and re-index when the model changes.
practices.prior_belief: Keep embedding dimensions and the embedding model consistent across all documents; include metadata that records which embedding model/version generated the vector so you can re-index if the model changes.
practices.source_name: documentdb-vector-search

practices.practice: Make index and collection creation idempotent: check for existing collections/indexes or use create-if-not-exists patterns so seeding scripts can be re-run safely.
practices.prior_belief: Make index and collection creation idempotent: check for existing index definitions before creating or use create-if-not-exists patterns so seeding scripts can be re-run safely.

practices.practice: Limit vector query results with a topK (k) and use pagination; choose sensible defaults (e.g., k=10) and allow callers to request fewer or more within safe bounds.
practices.prior_belief: Use pagination and a topK limit for vector queries (do not return unlimited hits); choose a modest default (e.g., topK=10) and allow callers to request fewer or more within safe bounds.
practices.source_name: Integrated vector store in Azure DocumentDB (vector-search)

practices.practice: Monitor RU/s (throughput), per-query request charge, index/storage usage, and alert on leading indicators (CPU, memory, IOPS, storage, connection saturation) so you can tune autoscale or RU allocation before incidents.
practices.prior_belief: Monitor RU/s (provisioned throughput), request charge per query, index storage, and RU throttling metrics in Azure Portal/metrics; tune autoscale or RU allocation if vector/index operations cause high RU consumption.
practices.source_name: documentdb-monitoring

practices.practice: Prefer autoscale (or appropriately-provisioned throughput) for workloads with expensive vector searches or traffic spikes and validate QPS vs RU consumption in staging.
practices.prior_belief: Prefer autoscale (or appropriately provisioned RU/s) for workloads that include expensive vector searches or spikes (do not rely on minimal fixed throughput), and test expected QPS vs RU consumption in staging.

practices.practice: Respect platform rate-limiting: back off on 429s, avoid tight retry loops, add jitter to retry delays, and limit retry attempts to prevent thundering-herd effects.
practices.prior_belief: Respect and implement the platform’s rate-limiting behavior: back off on 429s, avoid tight retry loops, and add jitter to retry delays to prevent thundering-herd effects.
practices.source_name: The Retry-After header: how long to wait before you retry

practices.practice: Rate-limit and cache embedding requests to external providers (e.g., Azure OpenAI), batch where possible, and provide deterministic or local fallbacks for offline tests.
practices.prior_belief: When using an external embedding provider (OpenAI), rate-limit and cache embedding requests, fallback to a deterministic embedding generator for offline tests, and never embed user secrets in the stored documents.
practices.source_name: Generate embeddings with Azure OpenAI / API Management caching guidance

practices.practice: Avoid storing unnecessary PII in provider documents; use PII detection, dynamic data masking, or redact fields not required for search to reduce privacy and compliance risk.
practices.prior_belief: Exclude or redact PII not needed for search; store only the attributes required (specialty, languages, insurance, short bio), and ensure any patient-identifiable data is not stored in provider documents.
practices.source_name: Dynamic Data Masking in Azure Cosmos DB / PII detection docs
practices.how_found: search for PII/dynamic masking guidance on learn.microsoft.com

practices.practice: Write idempotent unit and integration tests: seed known documents, use dedicated test collections or the local emulator, and avoid interacting with production data in tests.
practices.prior_belief: Write unit and integration tests that are idempotent against the shared database: seed known test documents, verify indexes and queries, and clean up or use a dedicated test collection/database to avoid interfering with production data.
practices.source_name: Optimize development and testing cost in Azure Cosmos DB (emulator / createIfNotExists)
practices.how_found: Optimize development and testing cost in Azure Cosmos DB

practices.practice: Avoid multi-document transactions for common read-heavy vector-search paths; prefer single-document atomic operations and optimistic concurrency where possible.
practices.prior_belief: Avoid multi-document transactions for common read-heavy vector search paths; prefer single-document atomic operations for upserts and use optimistic concurrency where necessary.

practices.practice: Normalize searchable text fields (lowercase, canonicalized language tags) at ingest so equality/index lookups and language matching are reliable.
practices.prior_belief: Project and store searchable text fields (bio, specialties) in normalized forms useful for filters (lowercase, canonicalized language tags) so equality/index lookups are reliable and language matching is consistent.
practices.source_name: documentdb-data-modeling

practices.practice: Keep documents reasonably small (well under the 16 MB BSON limit); if embeddings or large text increase document size significantly, store large fields externally and reference them to reduce RU and latency costs.
practices.prior_belief: Limit the size of individual documents (keep documents reasonably small) because large embedded vectors and metadata increase RU costs and latency; if necessary, store large text externally and reference it.
practices.source_name: documentdb-data-modeling

practices.practice: Prefer Microsoft Entra ID / Managed Identity for access to Azure resources over static keys; when the MongoDB wire protocol requires static keys, store them in Key Vault and rotate regularly.
practices.prior_belief: When possible prefer provider-managed secrets (Managed Identity / Azure AD) over static keys for access to Azure resources; if using the MongoDB wire protocol and static keys are required, wrap them in Key Vault and rotate regularly.
